Class AbstractStandardEventFormatter

java.lang.Object
io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.AbstractStandardEventFormatter
All Implemented Interfaces:
LogFormatter, LogFormatter.EventFormatter
Direct Known Subclasses:
JansiLogFormatter, StandardEventFormatter
public class AbstractStandardEventFormatter extends Object implements LogFormatter.EventFormatter
An abstract formatter where the actual full layout of the event is not a concern of the user and by default usually has the semi-standard layout of TTLL - Time, Thread, Level, Logger. It allows changing the format of time, thread, level, logger, etc. Typically the formatters get called in the following order.
  1. Timestamp
  2. Thread
  3. Level
  4. Logger Name
  5. Key Values if enabled
  6. Formatted Message
  7. Throwable if not null
If plugins would like to provide some sort of standard formatter they should extend this class as well as the AbstractStandardEventFormatter.AbstractBuilder.

  • Method Details

    • build

      public static LogFormatter build(LogFormatter timestampFormatter, LogFormatter threadFormatter, LogFormatter levelFormatter, LogFormatter nameFormatter, LogFormatter messageFormatter, LogFormatter throwableFormatter, LogFormatter keyValuesFormatter)
      Creates the standard default TTLL layout. This is largely the default of Log4J2 and Logback if no formatting is picked. An example of what the default roughly looks like: 
      17:47:33.163 [main] WARN  com.my.MyLogger - Hello Warn Message {k1=v1}
17:47:33.167 [main] DEBUG com.my.MyLogger - Hello Debug Message {k1=v1}
      Parameters:
      timestampFormatter - not null.
      threadFormatter - not null.
      levelFormatter - not null.
      nameFormatter - not null.
      messageFormatter - not null.
      throwableFormatter - not null.
      keyValuesFormatter - not null.
      Returns:
      formatter.
